scope: Recording under route change, disk overflow, panic and clip deletion, through the real desktop Session
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image (Qt 6.12, PipeWire 1.6.9), docker --network none, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, LD_PRELOAD fault injector, owned private PipeWire server at quantum 256
verified_behaviors: A disk slower than the take overflows the 2 s ring without delaying the capture side; dropped frames are whole blocks, reported, and disk + dropped = captured; the take still becomes a clip
Deleting the playing clip on an armed track while running and recording is accepted
Panic silences playback with no voice left while audio and MIDI takes keep recording; Stop adds both, closing the held note
Unlinking and relinking the live input mid-take keeps the take running; every non-silent frame is a reference frame in order and the gap is counted
limits: Stop waits for the worker to write what the ring holds (2.7 s with 100 ms writes). Route change is a software link change on the private graph, not a device switch; MIDI route change is covered by MidiTake's held-note closing, not a live unlink test.
